# First Intel Mac (10 Jan 2006)

**Source**: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=cp49Tmmtmf8

**Transcribed**: 2025-12-26 12:36

---

**[Steve Jobs]**: Let's talk about the computer systems themselves.

We're making some of the best products we we ever had. And we've had a really good year uh with Macs.

So we started off the quarter, started off the year selling over a million Macs a quarter and just did better every quarter after that. But the biggest news this year, of course, was that we announced that we were going to shift to using Intel processors in Macs. And we announced this at our developer conference this last spring. We announced that by June of this year, June of '06, we would be shipping Macs with Intel processors.

So I want to give you an update today. How are we doing?

Wow.

**[Paul Otellini]**: Steve, I wanted to report that Intel's ready.

**[Steve Jobs]**: Wow.

Well, I can report to you that Apple's ready too. Well, that's good. We started a partnership less than a year ago to make this happen. And our teams have worked so hard together, uh nights, weekends, uh to make this happen in record time. And I want to thank you and your team for all the help. It's been incredible how our engineers have bonded and how well this has gone.
**[Paul Otellini]**: Well, thank you, Steve. And and the collaboration from our side uh couldn't have been better in terms of working with with Apple. It was energizing, uh it was challenging, it was fun. We did inside of a year something which people thought couldn't be done. We had over a thousand people at Intel working on this project.

In in its entirety, what it reminded me most about was a quote that Bob Noyce, our founder, uh said almost 30 years ago. He said, "Don't be encumbered by history, go out and create something wonderful." Well, we did, and we did it together.
**[Steve Jobs]**: Yep.

You know, one of the biggest reasons that we decided to switch to using Intel processors is because what drives us is wanting to make the best personal computers in the world. And it became very clear that the way to do that was to use some of your newest technology that you'd be rolling out this year. And uh we are thrilled with it. We can't wait to tell you about it. So thank you, Paul.
**[Paul Otellini]**: Thank you very much, Steve. My pleasure.
**[Steve Jobs]**: Thanks.
